name: BVG Design Services
brand_truth: A Freeport web shop that has been putting Bahamian businesses online since 1996, when it built the Bahamas Vacation Guide.

design.signature: 1996 to 2026 time slider: a browser window wipes from a 1996-style page to a modern phone-first page as you drag (auto-plays once)

current_site_findings: Site served over plain http (https redirects to http), so browsers show 'Not secure'.
Menu buttons are images, unreadable by Google and screen readers.
Services still mention Myspace video ads.
Nassau and Abaco offices named with no contact details.
pitch_line: Your own site still says 2014 and 'Not secure': a web company's homepage is its portfolio, and this is what yours could look like tomorrow.
notes: Record said 'no own site' but research found bvgdesign.com (live, last updated 2014). Pitch carefully: they are a web design firm themselves, so the angle is 'your shop window is out of date' or a white-label/partnership conversation. Founders unnamed on their site. Prices page not used (dated); site says 'Rates on request'. Nassau/Abaco offices left off (no details, may be historic). Logo exists (https://bvgdesign.com/logobvg5bb.jpg) but not used; wordmark instead. Bahamas Vacation Guide link kept as http (their URL).
